verdict.rationale: Internal comment threads and @mentions on an email are a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only message CRUD, forwarding, categories, flags, delegation and standalone notes. None of these is a side-thread or @mention capability attached to a message.

support.subject: As a team-lead, we can discuss an email in an internal side-thread — comments and @mentions beside the message — instead of forwarding copies around
